MM-REQ-001.title: Pack voltage monitoring
MM-REQ-001.description: The BMS shall continuously monitor pack voltage throughout 400 V to 800 V DC.

conditions.description: lower bound coverage shall be at or below 400 V
upper bound coverage shall be at or above 800 V

clause_coverage.clause: The BMS shall continuously monitor pack voltage throughout 400 V to 800 V DC.

MM-REQ-002.title: Cell measurement accuracy
MM-REQ-002.description: Cell-voltage measurement error shall not exceed +/-5 mV from -20 deg C through +60 deg C.

conditions.description: the verified temperature range shall include -20 deg C
the verified temperature range shall include +60 deg C

clause_coverage.clause: Cell-voltage measurement error shall not exceed +/-5 mV from -20 deg C through +60 deg C.

MM-REQ-003.title: Crash disconnect response
MM-REQ-003.description: On a validated crash input, both main contactors shall open within 20 ms and the DC bus shall fall below 60 V within 5.0 s.

conditions.description: DC bus voltage < 60 V by 5.0 s

clause_coverage.clause: both main contactors shall open within 20 ms
the DC bus shall fall below 60 V within 5.0 s

MM-REQ-004.title: Post-impact isolation
MM-REQ-004.description: At 60 s after impact, measured isolation resistance divided by the measured DC-bus voltage shall be at least 500 ohm/V.

conditions.description: measurement taken at 60 s after impact

clause_coverage.clause: measured isolation resistance divided by the measured DC-bus voltage shall be at least 500 ohm/V

MM-REQ-005.title: Coolant circuit integrity
MM-REQ-005.description: The coolant circuit shall hold 2.0 bar for 30 minutes with no visible leakage.

clause_coverage.clause: The coolant circuit shall hold 2.0 bar for 30 minutes
with no visible leakage

MM-REQ-006.title: Service-disconnect hazard marking
MM-REQ-006.description: Every service-disconnect cover shall carry a readable yellow triangular warning label with a black lightning symbol before the cover can be accessed.

conditions.description: marking design is yellow triangle with black lightning symbol
conditions.threshold: yellow triangle with black lightning symbol

conditions.description: the marking is present and readable on every service-disconnect cover

clause_coverage.clause: Every service-disconnect cover shall carry a readable yellow triangular warning label with a black lightning symbol

MM-REQ-007.title: Thermal shutdown and recovery
MM-REQ-007.description: The BMS shall command shutdown at or above 85 deg C and shall permit recovery only after temperature is below 70 deg C for 60 s.

conditions.description: shutdown asserted at temperature >= 85 deg C
recovery requires temperature < 70 deg C continuously for 60 s

clause_coverage.clause: The BMS shall command shutdown at or above 85 deg C
shall permit recovery only after temperature is below 70 deg C for 60 s

MM-REQ-008.title: CAN heartbeat endurance
MM-REQ-008.description: The BMS CAN heartbeat interval shall not exceed 100 ms during a continuous 30-minute run, with zero lost heartbeat messages.

clause_coverage.clause: The BMS CAN heartbeat interval shall not exceed 100 ms during a continuous 30-minute run
with zero lost heartbeat messages

MM-REQ-009.title: Connector J17 ingress protection
MM-REQ-009.description: Connector J17 shall remain IP67 after 1 m water immersion for 30 minutes, with no moisture inside the rear boot.

clause_coverage.clause: Connector J17 shall remain IP67 after 1 m water immersion for 30 minutes
with no moisture inside the rear boot

MM-REQ-010.title: Instrument traceability
MM-REQ-010.description: Every measuring instrument used for acceptance data shall be identified by serial number and have calibration valid within 12 months on the test date.

conditions.description: each acceptance measurement identifies an instrument serial
each identified instrument has calibration age <= 12 months

clause_coverage.clause: Every measuring instrument used for acceptance data shall be identified by serial number
have calibration valid within 12 months on the test date

MM-REQ-011.title: Drive-away inhibition
MM-REQ-011.description: If the charge connector is engaged, commanded propulsion torque shall remain zero and vehicle movement shall not exceed 150 mm.

clause_coverage.clause: commanded propulsion torque shall remain zero
vehicle movement shall not exceed 150 mm

MM-REQ-012.title: Alternative post-impact electrical protection
MM-REQ-012.description: After frontal impact, electrical protection is acceptable when either the isolation ratio is at least 500 ohm/V or an isolation fault causes the main contactors to open within 100 ms.

clause_coverage.clause: the isolation ratio is at least 500 ohm/V
an isolation fault causes the main contactors to open within 100 ms
